entities.name: Yudelina Mejía
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yudelina Mejía Peguero is a Dominican Republic weightlifter. She won the silver medal in the women's 81 kg event at the 2023 Pan American Games held in Santiago, Chile. She is also a four-time medalist, including gold, at the Pan American Weightlifting Championships. Mejía represented the Dominican Republic at the 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris, France.
